label: Rucava white butter
note: Latvian PGI (2018): made by hand with a special churning method; soft, fluffy, slightly acidic; eaten fresh with boiled potatoes or rye bread

about.text: A hand-made Latvian butter (Rucavas baltais sviests) of 39-41 % fat, soft, fluffy and slightly acidic, eaten fresh with boiled potatoes or rye bread. It has a protected geographical indication (2018).

links.name: LSM: No buts, it's Rucava butter
